source_snapshot.procedure: Set LINK_TYPE_P1=1, DC cycle, configure an IB /24 address, then run paired taskset/ib_write_bw server and client with -F -b --report_gbits on port 3000.
source_snapshot.criteria: Bandwidth is about 90% of ideal; the source example maps 56 Gbps to a 6300 MB/s floor.

old_problem: The active record treated adapter identity, IP/GID/MTU, perftest profile and 90%-of-ideal math as unresolved review decisions. NVIDIA documents LINK_TYPE_P1=1 as InfiniBand and requires a reboot for activation; it also recommends ib_write_bw for inter-node bandwidth checks. Remaining values are safe project/runtime bindings when the formula and units are explicit.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits adapter, peer, address and finite-profile parameters; ED-05 keeps this InfiniBand case separate from Ethernet; ED-06 and ED-18 preserve the explicit DC transition; ED-14 prevents a shorter smoke substitute; ED-15 requires a link-specific, unit-consistent 90% threshold before PASS. The persistent mode change remains separately authorized and reversible.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row439 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3029 and adjacent row438 PTAT CPU plus row440 Ethernet-mode bandwidth cases.
Applied NVIDIA MFT semantics that LINK_TYPE_P1=1 selects InfiniBand and the setting becomes active only after reboot/cycle; current and next-boot values must both be captured.
Applied NVIDIA networking guidance that ib_write_bw is appropriate for inter-node bandwidth validation after confirming link width, speed, error state and port health.
Preserved P1=1, DC cycle, /24, CPU set 0-72, -F, bidirectional -b, --report_gbits and port 3000, subject to release help and valid NUMA/CPU availability.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row440 and verified its manifest identity; no mlxconfig, DC cycle, network configuration, traffic or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Mellanox P1 InfiniBand-mode activation and finite paired ib_write_bw 90%-of-ideal validation
test_case.purpose: Switch the exact approved port to InfiniBand mode through the required DC cycle, prove the active link identity/state, and measure finite bidirectional write bandwidth against a unit-correct link-specific 90%-of-ideal floor.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA MFT, firmware, OFED/rdma-core/perftest versions and release help
Adapter serial/MST/BDF/P1/netdev/IB-device/GUID/GID/NUMA/peer/cable map and saved prior LINK_TYPE/network state
Collision-free project-approved IB addresses, GID, MTU, link rate/width and fabric/SM state
Finite ib_write_bw message-size/QP/depth/duration or iteration/repeat/statistic profile and CPU-affinity validation
Approved payload-ideal formula, decimal/binary units and 90% threshold plus maintenance/OOB/DC-cycle/rollback plan
test_case.test_command: Verify immutable adapter/P1 and peer identity, save current/next-boot LINK_TYPE and network state, and show the exact `mlxconfig ... set LINK_TYPE_P1=1` mutation at a user hold point. Apply it once, perform the approved complete DC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycle, and prove active InfiniBand mode, expected rate/width/MTU/GID and clean link counters. Configure only the approved /24 addresses. Validate CPUs 0-72 against online/NUMA topology, then run the literal paired server/client taskset/ib_write_bw options on port 3000 under the approved finite limit and repeats. Compute the selected statistic against 90% of the negotiated link's approved payload ideal in consistent Gbit/s units, then remove temporary IP state and restore prior mode/network with the required cycle and post-health proof.
test_case.expected_result: The exact P1 reports InfiniBand as active after the full DC cycle, reaches the approved rate/width/MTU/GID state and remains error-free. Every finite server/client run completes with matched parameters and no link/fabric error; the approved throughput statistic is at least 90% of the approved payload ideal. The 56-Gbps/6300-MB/s example applies only when the verified link/formula matches it, and prior mode/network state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable adapter/peer identity, before/pending/active LINK_TYPE evidence, a complete DC transition, verified IB link/fabric state, exact finite paired outputs, valid CPU affinity, a documented unit-consistent 90% calculation and successful restoration. Missing threshold formula/profile or using the 56-Gbps example on another link is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Never change an unidentified port, shared management path or production fabric; require maintenance, OOB and explicit mutation/cycle approval
Capture prior mode/network state and verify both pending and active settings before traffic
Bound saturating bidirectional traffic, validate address/cpu/NUMA mapping and abort on link/fabric/thermal/RAS impact
Restore temporary IP and prior LINK_TYPE/network state; preserve logs and never auto-retry a mutation, cycle or benchmark
expected_evidence: Pinned stack and adapter/P1/peer/GUID/GID/NUMA/cable identity plus saved prior state
mlxconfig current/next-boot evidence and complete DC OFF/ON/OS-ready timeline
Active IB rate/width/MTU/GID/IP/fabric and pre/post link-error counters
Exact finite server/client commands, outputs, exits, affinity and repeat statistics
Payload-ideal/90% calculation, restored mode/network and post-health verdict
test_case.recovery: On mode, cycle, link or traffic failure, stop the benchmark, preserve state/counters, use OOB to restore the saved LINK_TYPE and network configuration through the separately approved cycle, and verify manageability/fabric health. Do not repeat mlxconfig, DC cycle or traffic automatically.
